relationships.subject: PSFL2874
relationships.evidence_quote: PSFL2874, a TRPV1 antagonist we discovered, is effective against inflammatory pain but devoid of binding to the S4-S5 linker and inducing CBT changes.

relationships.subject: S4-S5 linker
relationships.evidence_quote: We identified the S4-S5 linker region exposed to the vanilloid pocket of TRPV1 to be critical for hyperthermia associated with certain TRPV1 antagonists.

key_findings: The TRPV1 S4-S5 linker is critical for antagonist-induced hyperthermia.
PSFL2874 relieves inflammatory pain without altering core body temperature, indicating biased allosteric coupling of TRPV1 to nociception versus thermoregulation.
